mapper.select: SELECT inquiry_no AS inquiryNo, member_no AS memberNo, category, title, content, secret_yn AS secretYn, status, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM inquiry WHERE delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT inquiry_no AS inquiryNo, member_no AS memberNo, category, title, content, secret_yn AS secretYn, status, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM inquiry WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT inquiry_no AS inquiryNo, member_no AS memberNo, category, title, content, secret_yn AS secretYn, status, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM inquiry WHERE inquiry_no = #{inquiryNo} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET category = #{dto.category}, title = #{dto.title}, content = #{dto.content}, secret_yn = #{dto.secretYn}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inquiry_no = #{inquiryNo}
UPDATE inquiry SET status = #{status}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inquiry_no = #{inquiryNo}
